  {"step": 3, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-uswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_uswid_firmware_parse", "line": 137, "var": "payload", "code": "payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz, error)", "note": "Extracts the 15-byte coSWID CBOR payload from the uSWID file"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse", "line": 520, "var": "item", "code": "item = cbor_load(g_bytes_get_data(fw, NULL), g_bytes_get_size(fw), &result)", "note": "Parses the CBOR payload as a coSWID document; root is a map {0:'test', 6:{17:{7:[1,0]}}}"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse", "line": 548, "var": "pairs", "code": "pairs = cbor_map_handle(item)", "note": "Iterates root map pairs; finds tag_id=6 (FU_COSWID_TAG_PAYLOAD)"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse", "line": 585, "var": "pairs[i].value", "code": "fu_coswid_parse_one_or_many(pairs[i].value, fu_coswid_firmware_parse_payload, self, error)", "note": "Calls fu_coswid_firmware_parse_payload with the payload map {17:{7:[1,0]}}"},
  {"step": 7, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_payload", "line": 390, "var": "pairs", "code": "pairs = cbor_map_handle(item)", "note": "Iterates payload map pairs; finds tag_id=17 (FU_COSWID_TAG_FILE)"},
  {"step": 8, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_payload", "line": 392, "var": "pairs[i].value", "code": "fu_coswid_parse_one_or_many(pairs[i].value, fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file, self, error)", "note": "Calls fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file with the file map {7:[1,0]}"},
  {"step": 9, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file", "line": 270, "var": "pairs", "code": "pairs = cbor_map_handle(item)", "note": "Iterates file map pairs; finds tag_id=7 (FU_COSWID_TAG_HASH)"},
  {"step": 10, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file", "line": 274, "var": "pairs[i].value", "code": "cbor_isa_array(pairs[i].value) && cbor_array_size(pairs[i].value) >= 1", "note": "Hash value is array [1,0] with size 2, passes the array check"},
  {"step": 11, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file", "line": 283, "var": "pairs[i].value", "code": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash(pairs[i].value, payload, error)", "note": "Calls fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash with the hash array [1,0]"},
  {"step": 12, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash", "line": 207, "var": "item", "code": "cbor_isa_array(item)", "note": "Hash item is an array, passes the sanity check"},
  {"step": 13, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash", "line": 211, "var": "hash_item_alg_id", "code": "hash_item_alg_id = cbor_array_get(item, 0)", "note": "Gets alg_id = uint 1 (SHA256) from the hash array"},
  {"step": 14, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash", "line": 212, "var": "hash_item_value", "code": "hash_item_value = cbor_array_get(item, 1)", "note": "Gets value = uint 0 from the hash array; this is NOT a bytestring"},
  {"step": 15, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash", "line": 218, "var": "hash_item_alg_id", "code": "cbor_isa_uint(hash_item_alg_id)", "note": "alg_id is a uint, passes the type check"},
  {"step": 16, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash", "line": 226, "var": "hash_item_value", "code": "cbor_bytestring_handle(hash_item_value)", "note": "VULNERABILITY: cbor_bytestring_handle is called on a uint item without checking cbor_isa_bytestring; the uint value 0 is interpreted as a NULL pointer"},
  {"step": 17, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash", "line": 227, "var": "hash_item_value", "code": "cbor_bytestring_length(hash_item_value)", "note": "VULNERABILITY: cbor_bytestring_length is called on a uint item, reading 8 bytes from offset 8 of the cbor_item_t union (type/refcount fields), producing a garbage length"},
  {"step": 18, "file": "libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c", "function": "fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash", "line": 225, "var": "hash->value", "code": "g_byte_array_append(hash->value, cbor_bytestring_handle(hash_item_value), cbor_bytestring_length(hash_item_value))", "note": "g_byte_array_append reads from the invalid pointer with the garbage length, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ"}
]
</parameter>
